threat_event: Contractor agent's mailbox is taken over and a buyer receives altered wire instructions for cash to close
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 310 agents (19%) sign in without MFA; agents forward documents by email; no alerting on SaaS events; agents not in phishing simulations
existing_controls: Portal-only wire instructions; DMARC at reject; employee MFA; external-sender banner; wire fraud warnings in every contract packet; MSSP alerts on new forwarding rules
treatment_plan: Enforce MFA for every agent by 2026-11-15; add agents to phishing simulations; agent agreement duties (MFA, no forwarding of instructions); SaaS log alerting
exposure_estimate_usd: $60K-$250K per event; $1M funds transfer fraud sublimit

threat_event: Spoofed lender payoff letter or edited payee bank details divert a payoff disbursement from the title trust account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-02 two-person rule covers only new payees, not edits to existing payee bank details; some payoffs still arrive by email
existing_controls: Callback to verified numbers for new payees; dual approval and security keys for wire release; daily three-way reconciliation; positive pay
treatment_plan: Two-person rule for every payee edit in SYS-02; payoffs only from lender portals or callback to the lender's published number; daily reconciliation exception alert
exposure_estimate_usd: $150K-$400K per event plus trust account shortage; underwriter claim

threat_event: Fraudster changes a property owner's payout account, an agent's commission account, or a sales escrow refund payee, and the payment goes to the fraudster
threat_source: Cybercriminal; impersonator of owners or agents
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Owner portal allows bank changes without out-of-band check; agent payout changes accepted by email; sales escrow refunds need one approver
existing_controls: Positive pay on checks; monthly reconciliation; bank dual approval for title trust accounts only
treatment_plan: Out-of-band callback for every payee and bank account change in SYS-10 and SYS-13; dual approval on all three account types; 10-day hold on first payment to a changed account

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts the headquarters file server, integration service, and endpoints, and the attacker steals closing files for extortion
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broad access to the file server; non-expiring integration secrets; 6 of 40 critical vulnerabilities past target; restore of integration service and data warehouse never tested
existing_controls: EDR with 24x7 MSSP; immutable backups in a separate account; MFA for employees; segmented closing-room PCs
treatment_plan: Restrict the file server and move scanned files to encrypted cloud storage; vault integration secrets; restore tests; ransomware runbook and tabletop (P08)
exposure_estimate_usd: $1.5M-$4M (outage, response, notice to up to 98,000 consumers; insurance limit $10M)

threat_event: A compromised or departing user bulk-exports closing files from SYS-02 or SYS-01
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 31 staff hold unneeded export rights; SaaS export events not monitored
treatment_plan: Remove unneeded export rights; collect and alert on export events

threat_event: A departed contractor agent keeps access for days and takes client data to a competing brokerage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Average 6 days (up to 21) to disable; managing brokers report departures late; agent accounts excluded from inactivity rule
treatment_plan: Same-day disable triggered by license transfer feed and managing broker checklist; inactivity rule for agents; quarterly agent access review

threat_event: An agent browses other agents' transactions in the same office and misuses client data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-01 office-wide visibility (about 75 agents per office)
existing_controls: Confidentiality clause in the agent agreement
treatment_plan: Transaction-level visibility in SYS-01

threat_event: Attacker alters the wire instructions the Closing Communications Portal displays, through vulnerable code or the deployment pipeline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No code or dependency scanning; 3 shared developer credentials deploy without a company approver; no secure development terms
existing_controls: Annual external penetration test; WAF; MFA for portal users
treatment_plan: Named developer identities and company approval in the pipeline; code and dependency scanning; integrity check of displayed instructions against SYS-02; secure development terms

threat_event: An attacker takes over a buyer's portal account by SIM swap or a phone number changed by email
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Portal one-time code goes to a phone; number changes are not verified out of band
existing_controls: Number verified at contract; buyers told to call before wiring
treatment_plan: Callback before any portal phone number change

threat_event: The title production software vendor has an outage longer than the 8-hour MTD for closings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor RTO 24 hours versus BIA RTO 4 hours; no tested downtime procedure
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2; printed disbursement worksheet defined in P05
treatment_plan: Contract recovery terms at renewal; downtime drill; daily file export for funded files
exposure_estimate_usd: $45K per day plus lender and homebuilder relationship risk

threat_event: The transaction management platform has an extended outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No independent copy of transaction data; deadline tracking depends on the platform
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2; daily deadline export
treatment_plan: SaaS backup; downtime procedure

threat_event: The identity provider is unavailable and nobody can sign in
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single identity provider for all SaaS
existing_controls: Vendor high availability; break-glass accounts for critical systems; bank platforms use separate tokens
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: vendor availability record and break-glass accounts make a second identity provider unjustified

threat_event: Email, files, or transaction data are lost because a compromised administrator or the vendor deletes them, with no independent backup
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No independent backup of SYS-04 and SYS-01; 12 standing global administrators
treatment_plan: Independent SaaS backup service with separate credentials

threat_event: The integration service or data warehouse cannot be restored within the RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Restores never tested
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore tests starting 2026-12-15

threat_event: An attacker compromises the MSSP or a SaaS vendor and uses its access to reach company systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSSP EDR agents on every endpoint; SaaS admin integrations
existing_controls: SOC 2 reports at onboarding; MSSP contract with security terms
treatment_plan: Annual Tier 1 reviews (P09); MSSP access reviews

threat_event: A service provider with customer or consumer information has a breach and notifies late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 24 of 42 service providers without security terms; no annual reassessment
treatment_plan: Security and notice terms in every service provider contract; tiered annual reviews

threat_event: An FTC review finds that Title and Closing does not oversee the parent as its affiliate and service provider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Intercompany agreement has no security terms (314.4(a)(3)); no oversight record before 2026-09-29
treatment_plan: Amend the intercompany agreement; quarterly oversight meeting of the President of Title and Closing and the Qualified Individual

threat_event: The FTC opens an investigation after a notification event and finds program deficiencies
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Several 314.4 elements partially met (P03)
treatment_plan: Execute the P03 roadmap

threat_event: The FTC 30-day notice is missed because an agent knew of the event and did not report it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Discovery counts from any employee, officer, or other agent (314.4(j)(2)); agents untrained on reporting
treatment_plan: Agent reporting duty in the agent agreement and training; discovery date logged in P08

threat_event: Wire release staff are phished with an adversary-in-the-middle kit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High-value targets; heavy external email
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant security keys for all 46 wire release staff; bank hardware tokens
treatment_plan: Keep keys; add token-binding conditional access

threat_event: An impostor posing as the owner sells a property (often vacant land or a rental) and Title and Closing disburses the proceeds to the impostor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remote sellers verified by document upload; AI-005 identity verification thresholds not tuned; no in-person or notary check for remote vacant-property sellers
existing_controls: ID verification service; underwriter fraud bulletins
treatment_plan: Enhanced verification for remote sellers of vacant or non-owner-occupied property (known-notary signing, callback to the address of record); tune AI-005 thresholds

threat_event: A buyer wires the earnest money deposit to a fraudster posing as the brokerage or a title company
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Deposit instructions for the sales escrow account still sent by agents; unverified deposits found late
treatment_plan: Deposit instructions only through the portal; daily matching of expected and received deposits

threat_event: Closing documents with Social Security numbers sent by unencrypted email are intercepted or misdirected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Encryption only when the sender chooses (4 of 30 sampled emails)
existing_controls: TLS between mail servers where supported
treatment_plan: Automatic encryption for messages with Social Security or account numbers; portal-only delivery of closing packages

threat_event: Scanned closing files on the headquarters file server are copied by an insider or an attacker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 210 staff can read 2012 to 2018 closing files; no retention schedule
treatment_plan: Restrict to Title and Closing records staff; dispose of files past retention; move the rest to encrypted cloud storage

threat_event: Customer information kept indefinitely enlarges every breach and breaches the disposal rule
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No retention and disposal schedule (gap 7)
treatment_plan: Retention schedule and annual purge

threat_event: Paper closing files at 4 offices are taken or seen by unauthorized people
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unlocked cabinets
existing_controls: Office access during business hours only
treatment_plan: Locked cabinets; move files to headquarters records room

threat_event: An agent's personal laptop or phone with cached client documents is lost or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unmanaged personal devices; 40% of agents do not use the managed mail app
treatment_plan: Require the managed mail app for mobile access

threat_event: Client data leaks from agent phones into personal apps and cloud storage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No app protection where the managed mail app is not used
treatment_plan: Same as R-027

threat_event: An unpatched critical vulnerability on an internet-facing or internal system is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 of 40 critical findings past the 30-day target; internal scanning only since 2026-06
existing_controls: Quarterly external scans; automatic endpoint patching; EDR
treatment_plan: Monthly authenticated scans; remediation targets with escalation

threat_event: Long-lived integration secrets or the old portal database password are stolen and reused
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 7 non-expiring secrets in configuration files; database password from 2023
existing_controls: Network restrictions on the workloads account
treatment_plan: Move secrets to the key vault service with rotation; managed identities

threat_event: One of 12 standing SaaS global administrator accounts is compromised and used to create forwarding rules, export data, or change payee settings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standing global admin roles in the identity provider and productivity suite; 4 admins use everyday accounts in SYS-02 and the productivity suite
treatment_plan: Just-in-time SaaS admin roles; separate admin accounts; reduce to 4 global admins

threat_event: A SaaS security setting drifts (external sharing, legacy protocols, payee rules) without anyone noticing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No documented SaaS baselines
treatment_plan: SaaS security baselines and monthly drift report (STD-01)

threat_event: Look-alike domains impersonate the company or Title and Closing to clients
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Clients cannot easily tell look-alike domains apart
existing_controls: Domain monitoring by the email security vendor; portal-only instructions; client warnings
treatment_plan: Takedown service; client callback script

threat_event: Three secondary marketing domains with no DMARC policy are spoofed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No DMARC on 3 marketing domains
treatment_plan: DMARC at reject on every domain

threat_event: An employee with ledger access changes a payee to an account they control
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two-person rule incomplete in SYS-02 (see R-002)
existing_controls: Background checks; dual approval for wire release
treatment_plan: Two-person rule for all payee edits; review of payee change reports

threat_event: Someone tampers with network equipment in a key-only office closet
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 of 22 office closets key-only
existing_controls: Offices locked after hours; alarm systems
treatment_plan: Badge readers on all closets

threat_event: The MSSP misses or delays escalation of a high-severity alert
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contract SLA 30 minutes; 2 misses in the MSSP's last SOC 2 period
treatment_plan: SLA reporting and service credits

threat_event: A denial-of-service attack takes the portal down during a month-end closing peak
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Portal is internet-facing
existing_controls: Provider DoS protection and WAF; phone fallback (P05 BP-02)
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: provider protection plus the phone fallback keep this Low

threat_event: Tenant screening recommendations produce disparate outcomes by race or national origin
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recommendations used as decisions (override rate 2.1%); eviction filings and old criminal records counted; never tested for disparities
treatment_plan: P10 conditions: individualized review, configuration changes, quarterly disparity testing

threat_event: Inaccurate screening reports and missing adverse action notices for conditional approvals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Name-only record matches; notices sent only for declines
treatment_plan: Notices for every adverse action; second identifier for record matches

threat_event: Buyer lead scoring gives slower service to leads from protected-class proxies (ZIP code, language)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ZIP code and inquiry language used as inputs
treatment_plan: Remove proxy inputs; parity monitoring
owner: Director of Inside Sales and Relocation

threat_event: The leasing assistant chatbot steers prospects or gives answers that discriminate (for example on familial status or assistance animals)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Generative chatbot answers free-text questions; no testing for fair housing scenarios
treatment_plan: Fair housing test set; handoff rules; AI disclosure

threat_event: Staff paste client data into public generative AI tools or publish AI-drafted ads with discriminatory statements
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public tools used informally before the enterprise tool
treatment_plan: Enterprise tool with no-training terms; block public tools on company devices

threat_event: Identity verification for closings wrongly rejects legitimate signers or accepts a forged ID
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Thresholds not tuned; no performance data by age or document type
existing_controls: Closer review of every failed check
treatment_plan: Monthly accuracy review; fallback to known-notary signing

threat_event: The property management platform is down during the first-week rent window
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Rent concentrated in days 1 to 5
treatment_plan: Downtime procedure; contract availability terms
exposure_estimate_usd: $25K plus $1.9M per day of delayed rent

threat_event: The FinCEN residential real estate rule is reinstated on appeal with a short compliance window
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No reporting procedure ready
treatment_plan: Accepted by the President of Title and Closing: prepare a procedure only if the appeal succeeds

threat_event: The board of managers of Title and Closing does not receive the Qualified Individual's report and cannot oversee the program
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2025 report went only to the parent audit committee and omitted service providers and testing
treatment_plan: Annual written report to the board of managers covering all 314.4(i) items

threat_event: Lead data sent to the mortgage joint venture exceeds what the buyer consented to
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: API sends the full lead record
treatment_plan: Limit the API to consented fields
owner: Director of Inside Sales and Relocation

threat_event: A shared closing-room kiosk login is misused
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 kiosk logins open only the e-signature service
treatment_plan: Accepted by the President of Title and Closing: no customer information is reachable from the kiosks

threat_event: An acquired brokerage is connected before its systems, agents, and data are brought up to the company's controls
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Private equity roll-up strategy; no security integration checklist
treatment_plan: Security integration checklist and risk assessment before connection

threat_event: Analysts extract customer data from the data warehouse without approval
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Extract approval not enforced technically
treatment_plan: Mask Social Security and account numbers in the warehouse

threat_event: External auto-forwarding rules in agent mailboxes keep sending client email to outside accounts (found in P07; one rule created from an overseas IP address)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 agent mailboxes had external forwarding rules created before agent mailbox auditing and alerting started (2026-05); external auto-forwarding not blocked
treatment_plan: Remove the 6 rules (done 2026-08-28); block external auto-forwarding; investigate the attacker-created rule under P08 (opened as an incident 2026-08-28)
exposure_estimate_usd: $50K-$500K (notice if customer information was in the forwarded mail)
